name: LOW-VIX armed trend continuation — momentum ride in calm tape (BTC/ETH/SOL)
rationale: Thesis: trends persist when macro vol is suppressed; complacency is the regime where uptrends grind on with shallow pullbacks. Arm with VIX BELOW a calm ceiling (lt vix_ceiling, a BOUNDED level — the LOW direction of the gate), then require positive multi-week momentum (ret_Nd over mom_lookback gt mom_floor, SIGNED so the level gate is legitimate). Ride until trend rolls over (momentum lt mom_exit) or risk/time stops. Low turnover via a multi-week lookback. Disconfirmer 1 (is the low-VIX cap load-bearing?): the identical momentum-continuation long with NO VIX cap is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, the calm arm adds nothing and this is plain TS-momentum. Disconfirmer 2 (regime inversion): if the edge actually lives in the HIGH-VIX complement, the thesis is wrong and FAILs. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold or it is a single-bull-run artifact.
catalyst: VIX below calm ceiling AND positive multi-week momentum
